caption:
The video captures a tranquil sunset over a calm sea or large lake, seen from a pebble beach. A transparent crystal ball rests on the wet, rounded stones in the left foreground. It holds an inverted image of the horizon and sky within its curve. The sun sits low on the distant landmass to the right, casting a bright vertical column of glittering light across the open water beneath an orange-pink, lightly clouded sky.

The camera remains essentially fixed, and the ball holds roughly the same position and size. The visible motion instead lives in the water at the shoreline. Small ripples and a thin wash advance and recede across the wet pebbles in the foreground and to the right of the ball, shifting the waterline over time. The sun's reflection column shimmers and reshapes as the surface disturbs, while the bright spot inside the ball subtly changes in brightness without any new object entering the scene.
relations: A thin wash advances and recedes across the wet pebbles, shifting the shoreline waterline around the stationary ball.
Small surface ripples near the ball refract the horizon line, subtly altering the inverted image inside its curve.
Disturbance on the open water reshapes the glittering vertical reflection column beneath the low sun.
The ball stays fixed in position and size while the bright spot within it changes brightness as the water moves.
